title: A Merry Little Turn Up Girls Day!
seo_title: Merry Little Turn Up Girls Day in Joplin, MO
description: This annual Christmas party features a paint-by-numbers snowman craft and an optional small gift exchange, and you can do either, both, or just socialize. The craft kit costs $15 and includes a frame, numbered canvas, brushes, and numbered paints, and reserving a spot ahead of time is advised; bring a small wrapped gift under $25 if you join the exchange, and treats are provided. It is for girls and women, with no painting experience needed, on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM at Every BODY Fitness in Joplin, MO.
address: 2639 E 32nd St, Suite T,Joplin, Missouri, Joplin, MO
